question: Does a source-only bounded canonicalizer followed by one shared explicit family preset transfer across held scenes better than the same preset without canonicalization and a wrong-adapter control?

source_adapter.information_allowed: application source pixels, BO2 geometry and target dimensions only
source_adapter.statistic: per-channel median logit over warped valid source-only pixels
source_adapter.wrong_adapter_control: next lexicographic development scene in the same family, wrapping once

shared_preset.family: BO3 three-segment endpoint-fixed monotone curves then positive row-stochastic matrix

branches.pass: freeze adapter and shared-preset semantics, fit on all development scenes and run one untouched confirmation
branches.fail: close source-canonicalized shared preset without statistic, cap, operator, capacity or router rescue
branches.wrong_adapter_not_worse: close because source-specific canonicalization adds no identified information

forbidden: load target or reference pixels when constructing an application source adapter
change statistic, cap, operator or thresholds after formal execution
interpret adapter shifts as exposure, white balance, illuminant or scanner truth
call the family operator a film-stock response or calibration
claim_ceiling: one-author weak-paired source-only canonicalization plus explicit shared-preset development evidence; not physical exposure/WB, stock, calibration, product or commercial-use training
